text_block_list.text:
On the day of Valentine's, waiting outside 
the school gates was a mud-covered Bamboo 
Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, I prepared some chocolates to show my 
everyday gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Please, accept this!

Even as I accepted the chocolate, I 
couldn't help but worry about how covered 
in mud she was...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Man, honestly, so much happened before I 
could actually get this chocolate here...!
—A few hours prior.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We finally made it back. The sweet 
shop "Unexplored Region"... ...It really 
was an unexplored region!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's so good it brings tears to your eyes! 
The legendary chocolate you've got to try 
at least once in your life!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If those rumors are true... Heheh! I can 
already picture the look of joy on 
Trainer's face!

text_block_list.name: Wild Boar
text_block_list.text: Bof-bof...! Guhh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? A wild boar!? Why is that here of 
all—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me you're after my chocolate?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't pull on it! I'm giving it 
back! Hnnnngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Doryaaaaah!! Not this! I'm definitely not 
handing this over!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, the wrapping is totally ruined, 
ssui...! I'll have to rewrap it later... 
Huh?
(Rustle rustle rustle)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Monkey
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! Eeekeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A monkey this time?! It even entrances 
animals... As expected of legendary 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Wild Boar
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Grrrrrr...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Even that wild boar from earlier?! Ugh, 
talk about persistent...!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...I've chased down plenty of students 
breaking school rules. ...But I'm really 
not used to being the one chased."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So――from here on, it's a frontal 
breakthrough!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uwooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaaan! Please wait for me, 
'ssuuu--!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I was able to deliver it, 
su...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Um, I want you to try eating it right 
away! That's what I was looking forward to 
the most!
choice_data_list: Yeah, don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.text:
Exclusive chocolate from the sweet shop 
known as a "hidden paradise"... Its veil 
is finally...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! So this is the chocolate of the 
"Uncharted Land"...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Huh? Strange. It's kind of all 
mushy, ssir.

Inside the box was chocolate that looked 
as though it had just been melted in a hot 
water bath.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh! Shoot, that was my fault!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I was holding onto it so tightly so no 
one would take it, that the chocolate 
melted...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!! It really wasn't supposed 
to go like this, but...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh... But really, this is way too 
muddy...

If it's merely melted, there is no issue. 
You risked grave danger to deliver it to 
me. I shall gratefully partake!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Y-You'll really eat it...! Trainer...!

I pick out a piece of chocolate that 
barely held its shape and put it in my 
mouth. ...A rich cocoa aroma and an 
enveloping sweetness spread across my 
tongue...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's all falling apart... Ugh! 
Trainer, you're so kind! I'm so moved!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...But my gratitude isn't gonna lose to 
anyone else's!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's so hot it could melt chocolate! 
Heheh, watch out so you don't get burned!

Bamboo Memory's feelings of gratitude... 
This Valentine's Day, I received something 
far greater than chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! I'm going to remake this 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No way! I want to show my gratitude with 
proper chocolates...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's do this, ssir! Pour the 
chocolate into the molds and let it set 
again, ssir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"First, we gotta melt it down more! 
Starting the hot water bath, su!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll give Trainer... delicious chocolate! 
WOOOOOOAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm, not good enough yet!! More! Even 
more delicious! 
Doryaryaryaryaryaaaaaーー!!
(Splash-splash-splash...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Whaaaaat!? Almost all the chocolate 
flew off!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is... a single bite-sized 
piece!? No waaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Something this size isn't enough to 
express all my gratitude...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! It's just that I'm so 
clumsy...!
choice_data_list:
I'm just really happy you tried so hard 
for me.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I really can't give up after all! 
It might only be a small piece of 
chocolate, but—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna pour all my feelings into it and 
make it something real!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! No matter how many times I mess 
up, I'm definitely finishing it, boss!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! It's really 
just a single bite's worth, but—

Perhaps packed to the brim with her 
feelings, the chocolate had a warm weight 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
P-Please stop staring so hard! Just eat it 
already...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Um, once more! Happy Valentine's! 
...Heheh!
